edges.method: pin in pin hole (cockpit joined to body)

notes: The booklet pictures are small and ambiguous; the build is reconstructed to match the 38-piece parts list exactly (every type count verified).

Steps 1-3: technic brick b1 with two pins and two 1x1 round bricks on its side. Step 4: second technic brick b6 on top (assumed). Step 5 sub-assembly: technic b7 + pin b8, black jumper b9, trans-brown curved brick b10 and dish b11; then dark gray curved brick b12 on top.

Page 2 left (step 6) builds one wing with white round plate b19 and yellow left wedge; page 2 right (step 7) builds the mirror wing with yellow right wedge. Each wing has two side-handle plates, two flags, a tile, a clip plate and an antenna.
The wing attachment points to the cockpit body (rests_on of b13 and b26) are assumptions. The fourth pin (b30) is assumed to be in the hinge of the second wing.
position is null for all pieces.
